direction: Evolution of the multiplicative gate + rank-power ruin priority rule score_i = rank_power(|removal_savings_i|/scale * gate_load * gate_depot * gate_demand * gate_rdist, p(iter_frac, stagnation_ratio)), tuned toward the weakest regimes of dev_24 (tight capacity, uniform demand, n=100, eccentric depot): strengthen gate_load with a fill-ratio term (route_load/capacity) so near-full routes are ruptured first, add a dimensionless demand-over-slack term (demands_i/(capacity - route_load + demands_i)) to target customers whose removal frees scarce slack on tight instances, and make the rank exponent p monotone increasing in stagnation_ratio so early iterations exploit high absolute savings while stagnating iterations flatten the ranking toward diversification. Keep deterministic tie-breaking (index order) and all state arrays read-only.

operations.mechanism: KB entry method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3 is the verified parent of the active template: it fixes the LNS skeleton (CW + intra_2opt init, deterministic Regret-2 recreate, local intra_2opt, R2R acceptance, unified deadline clock) and reports that the evolved multiplicative-gate rank-power score_ruin_nodes beat the zero-evolution Worst-Cost-Removal control on blind_120 (23.3186 vs 23.3474). Since the archive shows all 7 candidates clustered within 0.09 objective units of the SBS, the remaining headroom is in stagnation-aware diversification (explicit 'strong_on: stagnation_aware_diversification') rather than in more LNS iterations; with a generous 2000 ms budget versus the KB's saturated 500 ms regime, more iterations are available to exploit adaptivity. Postprocess mode is kept 'none' as allowed, and only the whitelisted score_ruin_nodes hook is mutated.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: On dev_24 with a 2000 ms budget, the current LNS skeleton is empirically saturated near mean objective 16.05 (SBS 16.0496 across 7 archived solvers, VBS gap only 0.82%), meaning gains must come from per-iteration diversification rather than more iterations. I therefore claim that replacing a static multiplicative-gate rank-power ruin score with a stagnation-adaptive exponent plus capacity-slack-aware gating will reduce mean objective by >= 0.02 (i.e. below 16.030) on cvrp_dev_hetero_24, with the largest gains concentrated in the 'tight' capacity and 'clustered' spatial regimes where the VBS relative gap is most negative (-22.7% and -19.6%).
